name: Xperia 10 V

Network.SIM: nanoSIM, eSIM, 1 nanoSIM + 1 eSIM, 1 nanoSIM + 1 nanoSIM

Platform.Operating system: Android 13, Up to 2 major Android upgrades, 3 years of security patches, upgradable to Android 15
Platform.CPU: Octa-core, 6 nm, 2x2.2 GHz Cortex-A78 Kryo 660 Gold + 6x1.7 GHz Cortex-A55 Kryo 660 Silver

Battery.Battery: Non-removable Li-ion 5000 mAh, USB PD 3.1 21 W Charging
Battery.Charging: Fast Charging USB PD 3.1 21 W Charging
